caveats: Fine-tuned MACE-MP-0 (27 Gamma-only QE/GBRV force labels, SWA), 416-atom / 200 ps production tier: validation force RMSE 234 -> 62.4 meV/A, but the potential stiffens (Ea 0.265 -> 0.335 eV) and sigma drops to 0.45 mS/cm (0.14x experiment).
Foundation model over-predicts (1.8x), fine-tuned under-predicts (0.14x) -> they bracket experiment; the fine-tuned band [0.31, 0.66] sits entirely below 3.15 mS/cm.

Stiffening attributed to Gamma-only k-points + GBRV pseudopotential + the small 27-config (mostly near-equilibrium) dataset -- 'fine-tuned' does NOT mean 'more accurate' here (docs/REPORT.md section 5).
Nernst-Einstein ignores ion correlation (no Haven ratio).
Single-crystal upper bound: no grain boundaries (real polycrystals are lower).
Argyrodite shows non-Arrhenius transport; linear extrapolation to 300 K adds error.
